missions.name: Dead Stock Detection
missions.query: What products have been in inventory for over 365 days with a stock count of 0?

missions.name: Sizing Anomalies
missions.query: Which product styles have a size distribution that deviates from the global average by more than 20%?

missions.name: Supplier Delay Detection
missions.query: Which suppliers have consistently failed to meet their lead times, resulting in delayed restocking?

missions.name: Reorder Point Breaches
missions.query: Which products have had their reorder points consistently breached, leading to stockouts?

missions.name: Channel-Specific Stockouts
missions.query: Which sales channels have experienced the most frequent and severe stockouts across different product styles?

missions.name: Regional Stock Imbalance
missions.query: Which inventory locations have a significant stock imbalance compared to the global average?

missions.name: Supplier Performance Evaluation
missions.query: Which suppliers have the highest on-time delivery rates and what are the corresponding lead times?

missions.name: Price Elasticity Analysis
missions.query: How do price changes affect sales across different product styles and channels?
